title: A Heating Repair Visit
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: A brief exchange about arranging a heating repair.

transcript.text: The heating has stopped again. It was repaired Monday, but the radiators are cold. Can someone visit before the weekend?
We can send a technician Friday afternoon. Please clear the cupboard by the boiler so they can reach the controls.
Fine. I will move the boxes tonight and leave the side gate unlocked.

questions.prompt: What has happened to the heating?
options: It is making too much noise.
It only works in one room.
questions.explanation: The tenant says it has stopped working again and the radiators are cold.
The office offers a visit on Friday afternoon.

questions.prompt: What does the tenant agree to do?
options: Clear the cupboard and open the side gate
questions.explanation: The tenant will move the boxes near the boiler and leave the side gate unlocked.
